mechanism.protocol: Same current public harness, both shared mode, 2000case warmups plus72multi-shape warmups,101samples percase,3independent JVM pairs with reversed order. Fresh capture twice, plan, sameResources, reserve, scope, release. Constant-true predicates; not actual catalog/region/dispatch/server costs.

serverProtocol.common: Fixed .58/.59 binaries; identical VM/workload/current-operation safety rules.4workers,persistent,seed813584,CookTime100.1200warm ticks per count; main/control2x600measured ticks per count. Main2/64/256chunk in two independent JVM pairs with reversed order. SeparateOFF64chunk andON64regions pairs; profiled64chunk adds200recorder warmup then1200measurement ticks. All exact full-state/counter checks; native MSPT/CPU/allocation use inner-active subset. No competing build/test/probe/JFRanalysis.

manifest.note: Normal20TPS, unmodified installed binary, external read-only native JMX rings; metrics use only proven-active inner interval (+/-100ms) between unfreeze acknowledgment and last below-target gameTime query. Seed/layout/inputs/VM fixed per pair; no cold startup included. CPU100%=one logical core,8logical/4physical host.

before.methodology: Per-condition MSPT pools the configured consecutive inner-active windows in one JVM; not independent JVM repetitions or confidence intervals. Complete per-tick samples below. CPU/GC are MXBean deltas in these inner intervals. Exact body/state counters use the separately configured gameTick window. Native time ring endpoint ambiguity and observer overhead documented. No full-modpack or arbitrary BE speedup.

Native sample stacks are recorded separately; these include JVM idle/park/syscalls and are not added to Java execution sample percentages
Park time may include normal20TPS idle time, worker idle and managed joins; it is not evidence of resource-mutex contention
Monitor threshold1ms; absence does not exclude shorter locks or native VM waits
Native ring sample timing is bracketed by100ms polls, not exact JFR timestamped per-tick events; no unsupported pause-to-p99 causal attribution

separateProfiledBuilds.note: JFR diagnostic recordings excluded from primary timing comparison. Planner work now resides inside BlockEntityResourceOwnership, so combine ownership+dependency-planner categories when comparing caller totals. Weights are sampled estimates, not exact bytes or CPU time. Normal asynchronous compilation is not server blocking; parks include idle and joins.

conclusion.measuredGoal: Lower allocation and proof construction cost while preserving current-operation validation.
conclusion.unresolvedLatencyVariation: First regions pair has mean/p50/proof regressions with one184.856msmixedGC; no-GC window also regressed. Reversed repeat improves. No unsupported JIT/scheduler attribution.
limitations: Only4workers and the specified inert continuously-burning vanilla-furnace workloads were repeated across builds.
CPUfrequency/scheduling unpinned; prescribed warmup is not proof of final C2 stability.
Consecutive windows within a JVM are not independent repeats; primary and JFR datasets are separate.
JMXnative100slot ring brackets ticks and may miss indistinguishable equal-valued endpoints; exact gameTick/state/work counters cover full windows.
Maximum body concurrency is cumulative sinceboot; GCcollection time is not all STW time; JFRallocation weights are estimates.
